description:
*“Once I grow up, I am going to marry you, Yi-Chan!”*

From childhood, Seo Eu-Na adored his next door neighbor Kang Yi-Chan with absolute devotion. He followed him everywhere, chased off anyone who tried to get close to him, regardless of whether they were male or female, and declared him his future husband to anyone who would listen. To Yi-Chan, he was just a clingy little brother figure, unbearably persistent and impossible to shake off. So the moment he entered university, he disappeared from Eu-Na's life entirely, convinced he had finally escaped. Three years pass, and Yi-Chan returns from military service relieved that the nightmare is over. Until the first day of class. There, in his major lecture, sits a bright eyed freshman, smiling directly at him. Seo Eu-Na. He has grown up, followed him to the same university, and looks more determined than ever. This time, Yi-Chan might not be able to run.

(Source: Lezhin US)
